name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – § 2 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 2. Commends the peace initiative launched by the President of the United States, Donald Trump, since he took office; underlines that peace achieved as soon as possible via diplomatic means is in the interest of the peoples of both Ukraine and the EU; repeats that there is no military solution to the conflict that would favour Ukraine;
